jolpica.key_limitations: Lacks high-frequency car telemetry (speed, throttle, brake) and sub-second track intervals.

openf1.rate_limit_policy: Strict rate limiting enforced (HTTP 429 encountered under rapid queries); requires client-side 0.3s–0.5s pacing

audited_endpoints.sessions: VERIFIED (FP1, FP2, FP3, Qualifying, Sprint, Race)
audited_endpoints.laps: VERIFIED (Lap times, sector 1/2/3, pit out flag)
audited_endpoints.pit: VERIFIED (Lane duration, stop duration, pit lap)
audited_endpoints.intervals: VERIFIED (Gap to leader, interval to car ahead)
audited_endpoints.stints: VERIFIED (Tire compound, tire age at start, stint length)
audited_endpoints.race_control: VERIFIED (Safety car, VSC, flags, track limits)

openf1.key_limitations: Does not cover pre-2023 seasons; unthrottled burst requests trigger HTTP 429.

fastf1_upstream.error_reason: Specific tested static archive endpoints return HTTP 401 Unauthorized unauthenticated; requires F1 account token ('f1auth.json') or local cache
fastf1_upstream.architectural_recommendation: Use OpenF1 as primary unauthenticated telemetry source for modern era (2023–2026) and Jolpica for historical sporting ground truth (1950–2026). FastF1 remains functional when provided with user tokens or pre-cached raw session files.

initial_forecasting_dataset_recommendati.historical_baseline_era: 2018–2025 (Complete) + 2026 YTD via Jolpica (Qualifying order, starting grid, race results, driver/constructor Elo ratings)
initial_forecasting_dataset_recommendati.multimodal_telemetry_era: 2023–2025 (Complete) + 2026 YTD via OpenF1 (Practice long-run pace, tire degradation slopes, live intervals, track weather)
initial_forecasting_dataset_recommendati.first_baseline_model: EXP-0001: Rolling Elo & Historical Rating Baseline evaluated on rolling-origin splits (2018–2024 train/validate, 2025–2026 test)
